# Series 12

## Exercise 12.1




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(AER)
data("Guns")
```
:::




### A

#### I

```

```
   Length  N.unique   N.blank Min.nchar Max.nchar 
        1         1         0         4         4

#### II




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# verify that panel is balanced
years <- length(levels(Guns$year))
states <- length(levels(Guns$state))
years * states == nrow(Guns)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] TRUE
```


:::
:::




The dataset is balanced!

### B

#### I




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(plm)

model.se <- plm(
    formula = log(violent) ~ law,
    data = Guns,
    index = c("state", "year"),
    model = "within"
    )

model.se
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

Model Formula: log(violent) ~ law

Coefficients:
 lawyes 
0.11366 
```


:::
:::




#### II




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
coeftest(model.se, vcov. = vcovHC, type = "HC1")
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

t test of coefficients:

       Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)   
lawyes 0.113663   0.035689  3.1848 0.001488 **
---
Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
```


:::
:::




#### III




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
model = plm(log(violent) ~ law, data = Guns, index = c("state", "year"), model = "pooling")

pFtest(model.se, model)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

	F test for individual effects

data:  log(violent) ~ law
F = 260.5, df1 = 50, df2 = 1121, p-value < 2.2e-16
alternative hypothesis: significant effects
```
